items.statement: The template package raises the proportion of case discussions documenting all seven items from about 54 to at least 74 percent.
items.rationale: Similar packages raised completeness by 22 to 33 points (claims c1, c2).

items.statement: Complete documentation shortens the median time from discussion to first treatment by at least 5 days.
items.risks: Confounding by complexity; smaller effect under randomised order.

items.statement: Meeting duration returns to baseline within three months of adoption.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected as the primary question.
